benchmark_metadata.metric_scope_disclosure: Precision, recall, FPR, and FNR are scenario-level metrics evaluating whether CloudShield classifies each of the 7 test scenarios into the correct high-level verdict. They do NOT represent individual request-level packet inspection metrics.
benchmark_metadata.ttd_measurement_caveat: Time-To-Detect (TTD) resolution is limited by the 4.0s background evaluation loop in backend/app/main.py and the 0.5s observer polling cadence. Observed TTD values are discrete measurements quantized to evaluation intervals (~4s, ~8s), not continuous line-rate detection latency.
limitations_and_residual_state: Nginx access log telemetry uses a 10s sliding window; an 11s pause is enforced between scenarios.
EWMA baselines in entropy_engine evolve dynamically on normal traffic and are not hard-reset.
Docker Desktop on Windows NATs direct host connections to 172.28.0.1; simulation channel is required for synthetic source IPs.
